rejected.source_title: Sheriff credits license plate readers in capture of murder suspect in Vero Beach killing - WPEC

lead_independence.headline: Sebastian man arrested in West Virginia for Vero Beach homicide after license plate readers track multi-state flight
lead_independence.lead: Sheriff Eric Flowers credited the agency's Real Time Crime Center and a network of license plate readers with helping investigators piece together Matthew Waggle's movements and locate him after the Aug. 16 fatal shooting in Vero Beach. Waggle was arrested on Aug. 19 at a motel in West Virginia in connection with the death of Dawn Kriskewicz.
